pageTitle: Klacks for SMEs | Workforce Scheduling Without License Fees
metaDescription: Klacks plans shifts and tours, checks rest periods and qualifications, and runs on an office PC or your own server. Open source, no license fees.
hero.title: Workforce scheduling for small and medium-sized businesses
hero.subtitle: Do you schedule with Excel, on paper or in a group chat today? Klacks plans shifts and tours, checks rest periods and qualifications, and runs on your side: on an office PC or your own server. Open source, no license fees.
hero.growth: Developed and tested with a dataset of 5,000 employees.
benefits.title: What Klacks takes off your hands
benefits.items.0.title: Shift schedule with rules
benefits.items.0.text: Klacks knows rest periods, qualifications, public holidays and surcharges. For many countries, a country pack brings these rules along right away.
benefits.items.1.title: Replace absences faster
benefits.items.1.text: If someone drops out, Klacks suggests a replacement who has the required qualification and observes the rest period.
benefits.items.2.title: Ready for the payroll office
benefits.items.2.text: At period closing, Klacks creates the payroll export. The employee list can be exported as well.
needs.title: What you need
needs.subtitle: Klacks runs on your side, not in someone else's cloud. There are two ways to do this.
needs.pc.title: On an office PC
needs.pc.items.0: A Windows computer with Docker Desktop that is running during working hours
needs.pc.items.2: Your team reaches Klacks on the office network; access from outside is not set up
needs.pc.items.3: Klacks installs new versions there automatically
needs.pc.items.4: Docker Desktop is free for businesses with fewer than 250 employees and less than 10 million USD in annual revenue
needs.pc.items.5: Klacks was developed and tested with a dataset of 5,000 employees; how smoothly it runs on your PC depends on the PC's performance
needs.server.title: On your own server
needs.server.items.0: A Linux server with at least 8 GB of memory and 4 CPU cores
needs.server.items.1: Klacks installs new versions there automatically
needs.server.items.2: Suitable if you already run a server or have one managed for you
needs.note: Allow about half an hour for the first start, depending on your computer and internet connection.
data.title: Your data
data.text: You enter employees directly in Klacks or import them from an Excel or CSV file; a preview shows you what is missing before anything is saved. You can also take over employees from LDAP or Active Directory by synchronising; your people can sign in via OpenID Connect or OAuth 2.0 as well. Your data stays in your installation, in the open PostgreSQL database. You run the AI assistant with the model of your choice, including a local one.
help.title: Help
help.text: Send your questions by email; the founder handles inquiries personally. Texts written by an AI are labeled as such.
cta.title: Want to try it first?
cta.text: In the Playground, you test Klacks with sample data right in the browser, without installation and without registration.
